label: Paleobiology Database: fossil occurrence counts per taxon (taxa/single, show=size) retrieved 2026-10-31
bibliographic_citation: The Paleobiology Database (2026) Data Service 1.2, taxa/single with show=size. https://paleobiodb.org, accessed 2026-10-31. See Peters SE, McClennen M (2015) The Paleobiology Database application programming interface. Paleobiology 42:1-7. doi:10.1017/pab.2015.39

counts.description: taxa with at least one fossil occurrence in PBDB (per-taxon occurrence counts in taxa_coverage)
sum of PBDB occurrence counts over the listed taxa (overlapping for nested taxa)

measurement_technique: Literature-compiled fossil occurrences (collection x taxon) with geologic age and locality; counts are the database's per-taxon occurrence totals including subtaxa.
role: fossil record depth (number of occurrences, number of subtaxa) for the listed taxa; subspecies queried at species rank
